source_ref.note: Frozen detached git worktree of the reviewed commit; the main checkout continues UI development. Recon agents launched before the freeze read /home/user/meimeioneth while it was identical to this commit.

budget.revision: Raised by the parent from 40 to 52 after wave 1 produced 14 unique candidates (user set no budget): 14 Phase-3 verifiers + up to 14 Phase-5 record verifiers + 2 critics + slack for material Phase-5 replacements. Raised again to 56 because Phase-3 verifier v3-03 returned malformed JSON (outer object closed before 'check') and was discarded unrepaired; a fresh verifier v3-16 re-runs that candidate, plus slack for Phase-5 material replacements.

controls: env cleared before any shell (no BASH_ENV/rc); outer uid nobody
new user+net+mount+pid namespaces; no external network; isolated loopback only
pivot_root into a fresh tmpfs root with read-only binds of /usr, /etc, /opt/lexiflow-audit-cp and the frozen target only; host root detached (no host homes, /run, unix sockets, /var, host /tmp)
fresh /proc for the private pid ns; minimal /dev (null, zero, full, random, urandom, tty)
writes only to agents/<id>/scratch (16 MiB tmpfs, bind-mounted at /sbx); private 1 MiB /tmp /var/tmp /dev/shm; root skeleton read-only
target runs with zero capabilities, securebits noroot locked, no_new_privs
per-run cgroups: memory 2 GiB aggregate, pids 256; prlimit AS 6 GiB, CPU 120 s, 512 procs, 16 MiB per file, 512 fds, no core; timeout <= 300 s; cgroups removed after the run
sandbox.runtime_classpath: /opt/lexiflow-audit-cp rebuilt by the trusted parent from LexiFlow/backend installDist; core/backend sources are byte-identical to the reviewed commit (git diff 0cf6d49..HEAD empty for core, backend, settings, gradle). backend.jar sha256 92692994…, core.jar sha256 6fa7dc34…
limitations: Android framework code (app/) cannot run in the JVM sandbox; Robolectric/Gradle need the host Gradle home and are not run as target-controlled code in this audit
agent tool isolation is instruction-enforced: delegated agents are told to execute target code only through tools/sandbox.sh
sandbox.self_test: 2026-10-18: egress ENETUNREACH, loopback ok, /run and host homes absent, caps all zero, NoNewPrivs=1, / and /etc read-only, 3 GiB allocation OOM-killed by the memory cgroup
sandbox.version: v2 (v1 gaps from recon fixed: pre-mount host write, writable host dirs, telemetry unix socket, readable homes, no aggregate memory/pids bound, host /proc, BASH_ENV, header path)

promotion.note: promote.py v2: refuses while any sbx-<agent>-* cgroup exists; flock on artifacts dir; ino/dev/size/nlink/type/mtime/ctime re-checked; full-write loop + fsync; partial destination unlinked on failure; unexpected errors fail closed

hunter_prompt_delivery: Each hunter prompt is assembled verbatim by tools/build_prompts.py into agents/<id>/PROMPT.md (parent-owned) and delivered by instructing the agent to read it first; the Task prompt carries the role preamble.

discarded_results.reason: malformed JSON: extra data after the outer object (decision/record closed before check); discarded without repair per VALIDATION-AND-REPORTING Phase 3

Verifier v3-16 lost its scratch evidence, so its check is recorded source-only. Rate-limited agents p5-08, p5-11, p5-13 and v3-16 were resumed (same agents) after the reset.
